title: Grandpa and Grandma
subtitle: 考点：家庭成员 / 一般现在时 / next to
passage: My grandparents live next to our house. Every day, they spend a lot of time together. Grandpa plays Chinese chess with his friends in the park. Grandma is a member of a dancing club.
At night, they sit together and listen to the radio. They laugh a lot because Grandpa is very funny.
vocab: grandparent 祖父母 · spend 花费 · member 成员 · laugh 笑 · funny 好笑的 · listen to 听 · next to 紧邻 · at night 在夜晚
